Method Notes.Details: First-pass semantic consolidation of the 367 existing topic labels into higher-level SMDIs.
367 BERTopic-derived topic labels with descriptions, keywords and representative-post evidence.
Topics were grouped by substantive discussion theme while keeping distinct constructs separate to avoid excessive over-aggregation.
Inspect representative posts for borderline groups and then conduct human/LLM label validation before treating these as final SMDIs.
The SMDI labels are analytical categories; they are not new BERTopic topics and should be reported as a separate consolidation/interpretation stage.
